notes: Risk, not a failure: the refresh loop's fetch (operator.do → http.DefaultClient with the loop's cancel-only context) has no per-request deadline, so a stalled connection through a port-forward blocks the tick until TCP gives up; the daemon's own appauth client has no deadline either, so this is the codebase's existing pattern, not a regression.

The read pass's refusedReviews memo is keyed by review id while its judgement depends on the reviewer's recorded session; a review-App review set aside under one recorded session stays refused for the process even if the reviewer's claim later records another session. Correct by plan D1 (a new reviewer session never posted that review), noted for the record.
